items.title: Jonathan Scales interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 23, 2025
items.q: I think about like Herbie Hancock who is still touring.

ctx.x: Yeah. So I’m going to wrap this up. This has been fascinating just with returning to where we started, you’re going down this hallway from your TED talk and there’s doors to be opened. Do you anticipate any more doors that you could come across now that you’ve done this for 19 years? What might be a door to open and pursue?

Okay so there’s a couple of ways to answer that question. There’s the right way, which is just to say something that I hope will happen or something. Right? But then there’s the other way where you realize that like yes I’ve been doing this for 19 years but like I feel like this is still the beginning for me. Like when I think about the trajectory of like what it © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-

means to be a composer, an artist, in the way that I am, I think about like Herbie Hancock who is still touring. And Chick Corea who was still touring until he passed. You know what I mean? I think about like people like that and I see, man I’m – right now, even though I’ve been doing it for 19 years and I’m 41, this is the oldest I’ve ever been, so I can feel old but like I can also see, man, there’s no way I can tell where things are going to be in 20 years let alone 10 years, let alone 5 years at this…
